title: Leap Year
statementMd:
A year is a **leap year** if it is divisible by 4 — except century years (divisible by 100), which are leap years only if they are also divisible by 400. Print `Leap` or `Not leap`.

**Input**
One integer `year` (1 ≤ year ≤ 9999).

**Output**
`Leap` or `Not leap`.
hints: 1900 is NOT a leap year but 2000 is — combine the rules with && and ||.
